{{Quote|Unless Naeshahn was aware of this, her first meeting with the Yinchorri could have&mdash;''"<br />"''Ended in disaster, as it did...|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]]|<ref name="Jedi Council: Acts of War 1">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 1|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''first mission to the Yinchorri system''' occurred in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]].

==Background==
After news of the [[Battle of Mayvitch 7]] reached the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] requested that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] send a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team to [[Yinchorr/Legends|Yinchorr]] to negotiate. Without discussing it with the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], Windu sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Naeshahn]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ebor Taulk]].

==The mission==
The two were unaware of the Yinchorri immunity to [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricks]], use of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] weaponry, or aggression. The Jedi were [[Death/Legends|killed]], their mutilated bodies later deposited upon Valorum's [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] doorstep.
